title: CryptoSight AI
description: Live market charts, structured AI analysis and risk tools.
disclaimer: Educational analysis only. Not financial advice. Crypto trading carries a high risk of loss.
educational: Educational analysis, not financial advice. Crypto trading carries a high risk of loss.
consentText: AI can be wrong. Levels and confidence are uncertain estimates. You are responsible for your decisions. This app never places real exchange orders.
keyHint: Encrypted on the server. Existing keys are never returned to your browser.
confidenceHint: Subjective estimate, not a measured success probability
liquidation: Liquidation price unavailable without venue margin tiers
scoreHint: Rule-based score; not an AI prediction
paperHint: Paper trading only: isolated collateral cap, simulated balance and order-book fills with fixed fees. No real trades or venue liquidation model.
trackHint: All signals are retained. Same-bar stop/target or entry/exit conflicts are ambiguous; they are never counted as wins.
verificationRequired: Check your email to verify your account
resetSent: If the account exists, a reset email will be sent
deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and its private records. Enter your password to confirm.
demoHint: Synthetic sample candles. Not live data. AI generation and paper orders always use actual exchange data.
backtestHint: SMA crossover, up to 3,000 candles. No lookahead; next-bar fills. Open positions and fee assumptions are shown.
drawHint: Select a tool, then mark points on the chart
chartUnavailable: Market data could not be loaded. Retry or use the clearly labeled sample replay.
aiEmpty: Choose a provider and model, then analyze the current market.
drawingLocal: Sign in to save drawings across devices
eventWarning: Economic calendar unavailable. Check high-impact events before making decisions.
loginRequired: Sign in to use this feature
help: Keyboard: A analyze · Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo · Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z redo
err_credential_required: Add your AI API key in Settings
err_insufficient_fresh_data: Fresh market data is unavailable; no analysis generated
err_daily_limit: Daily budget or analysis limit reached
err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later
err_encryption_not_configured: Server encryption key must be configured
err_service_unavailable: Service unavailable. Check configuration and connection
err_version_conflict: This record changed elsewhere or a replay key was reused with different input. Refresh before retrying.
err_already_exists: An account or record already exists
err_ai_validation_failed: AI response failed validation; no signal was published
err_analysis_failed: Analysis failed. Check provider availability and key
scanQueued: Analyses queued. Each coin uses the displayed reservation; available daily limits apply.
briefHint: BTC multi-timeframe analysis, once daily while enabled. Uses your selected model and daily budget. Manage or delete its schedule in Alerts.
verifyEmailBody: Verify your email using this link:
resetEmailBody: Reset your password using this link:
walletNone: No wallet found. Open this site in a wallet browser or install an EVM wallet extension.
walletHint: Sign a login message. No gas fee, token approval or transaction. Email is optional for wallet accounts.
walletConsent: I accept the educational-analysis disclaimer and account terms shown above.
walletSignAuth: Sign in or register with CryptoSight AI. This signature authorizes login only, not transactions.
walletSignLink: Link this wallet to your signed-in CryptoSight AI account. This signature does not authorize transactions.
walletSignUnlink: Unlink this wallet from your CryptoSight AI account and revoke all account sessions.
walletSignedOut: Wallet unlinked. All account sessions have been signed out.
walletLastMethod: Link another wallet before removing your only login method.
err_wallet_chain_unsupported: This wallet network is not enabled. Switch to an enabled EVM network and retry.
err_wallet_challenge_invalid: The login request expired, was already used, or belongs to another browser. Please retry.
err_wallet_signature_invalid: The wallet signature is invalid. Please retry with the selected account.
err_wallet_already_linked: This wallet belongs to another account. Sign in to that account instead.
err_wallet_last_login_method: You cannot remove your last login method. Link another wallet first.
err_wallet_totp_required: Enter a valid two-factor code, then retry wallet signing.
err_wallet_rejected: Wallet request declined. You can try again.
err_wallet_pending: A wallet request is already open. Finish or dismiss it in your wallet.
err_wallet_changed: The wallet account or network changed while signing. Retry with your chosen account.
err_wallet_unavailable: No compatible wallet provider is available.
err_wallet_use_link: You are already signed in. Link wallets from Settings.
oauthMfa: Complete Google sign-in with your two-factor code
err_email_required: This account needs a verified email for email alerts. Use in-app, Telegram or push alerts.
verificationSent: If the account needs verification, a verification email will be sent.
err_wallet_address_invalid: Invalid wallet address or checksum. Choose a valid account in your wallet.
adminHint: Manage application access, server-side AI agents and operating limits.
adminInstructionsHint: These preferences supplement the analyst prompt. Evidence rules, uncertainty and output validation always apply.
adminKeyHint: Encrypted at rest. Leave blank to keep the existing key. Saved keys cannot be displayed.
adminNoAgents: Add an agent, save its API key and enable it to make it available in analysis tools.
adminLocalHint: The local endpoint and optional key are configured on the server through LOCAL_LLM_URL and LOCAL_LLM_KEY.
adminTestPassed: Provider responded. The test consumed the administrator’s AI allowance.
adminTotp: Current 2FA code for the next change
adminPauseHint: Pausing blocks new AI requests and queued analyses. Already-running provider calls may finish. Charts and account access remain available.
adminSearchUsers: Email, wallet address or user ID
adminSessionsHint: Saving access changes signs the user out. Suspension also disables their schedules. Restoring access does not reactivate schedules.
adminJobsHint: Latest 100 analyses. Only queued jobs can be cancelled; their cost reservation is released once.
adminDeleteAgentHint: Delete this agent and its encrypted API key? Pending analyses that use it will fail. Historical results remain available.
admin_self_lockout: You cannot remove your own administrator access or delete your administrator account.
admin_last_admin: At least one active administrator must remain.
ai_paused: AI requests are temporarily paused by the administrator.
agent_unavailable: The selected agent is disabled, missing or unavailable for your plan.
agent_changed: The agent changed after this job was queued. Start a new analysis.
job_not_queued: This job is no longer queued and cannot be cancelled.
name: Name
paperRefresh: Refreshes every 10 seconds while visible. PnL includes entry and estimated exit fees; execution uses order-book liquidity.
paperMissingQuotes: Some prices are unavailable. Account valuation is incomplete.
paperHistoryLimit: Latest 200 exit executions, including partial closes. Statistics cover the entire account history.
paperFee: 0.1% fee per side; actual fill may differ
paperExitPending: Protective exit triggered. Waiting for fresh executable liquidity.
paperDemoBlocked: Sample replay: opening simulated orders is disabled.
paperWorkerWarning: Paper worker is not responding. Pending orders and SL/TP will not execute automatically until it resumes.
paperInvalidProtection: Check stop and target levels for the selected direction.
paperProtectionHint: SL/TP are optional. Exits use available order-book liquidity, so the fill can differ from the trigger price.
paperStale: Account data is stale. Refresh or check your connection before opening a position.
err_invalid_risk: Check quantity, risk and SL/TP levels for the chosen direction.
err_stale_quote: No fresh executable quote. Refresh and try again.
commandHint: ↑ ↓ to select · Enter to open · Esc to close · Ctrl/Cmd K anywhere
resetWorkspaceHint: Restore the default market, chart, indicators and panel order
noMarketData: Market quotes unavailable. Waiting for the provider.
quotesStale: Quote refresh failed — showing the last response
journalScope: Based on the latest {count} recorded entries (maximum 200). Includes recorded fees. The curve follows recording order; it is not total account equity.
pnlCurveDescription: Net PnL after {count} recorded trades: {pnl} USDT. Detailed results are in the journal table.
riskCostHint: Fees and slippage are estimated on entry and exit. 1 basis point = 0.01%. Funding and venue liquidation rules are excluded.
riskWarning_high_leverage: High leverage increases sensitivity to price movements.
riskWarning_high_account_risk: This trade risks at least 2% of the account.
riskWarning_collateral_capped: Position size was capped by the available collateral.
riskWarning_target_below_costs: The target does not cover the estimated trading costs.
mobileConnectHint: Approve only if you just started signing in from the CryptoSight AI app on your phone. Your password and provider keys stay on the server.
mobileConnectExpired: This sign-in request is invalid or expired. Start again from the mobile app.
mobileConnectSuccess: Account connected. Return to the mobile app.
modelsHint: Save the provider key and fetch models. You can also enter a model ID manually.
err_provider_key_rejected: The provider rejected this key or denied access to the model list.
err_model_catalog_unavailable: Could not fetch models. Retry or enter a model ID manually.
evidenceHint: Server calculations from closed candles. These are not predictions of success.
orderbookHint: Visible liquidity can disappear; it is not executed order flow.
costsExceedReward: Assumed costs exceed the gross reward.
costAssumptionsHint: Comparison assumes 10 bps fees and 5 bps slippage per side, plus spread when available. Funding and price gaps are excluded. Break-even rate is not a predicted win rate.
candidateScanHint: Scan the highest-turnover pairs on the selected venue. Two-timeframe technical rules, with no paid AI calls.
candidateStale: Results are stale. Run another scan before evaluating an entry.
candidatePartial: Partial scan: some data was unavailable or the time budget was reached.
candidateNone: No setups meet every condition. Change timeframe or review the watch candidates.
candidateSpotShort: SHORT is a bearish scenario. Ordinary spot without borrowing does not allow short selling.
candidateWatch: Watch candidates — conditions not yet met
candidateScoreHint: The 0–100 ranking measures rule confluence, not probability of profit. No result means an automatic entry.
candidateLevelsHint: Levels are approximate and not rounded to exchange tick size. Net R:R assumes 30 bps round-trip costs, excluding spread and funding. Open the chart and run an analysis before deciding.
watchlistScansHint: The AI scan below is separate and uses your model key and analysis budget. Finding setups above does not require an AI key.
aiFitPlan: Fit scale to SL and TP
aiNotesMissing: This analysis has no separate note for this level. The original AI rationale is below.
aiChartNotesHint: Notes come from this AI analysis. The drawing is a conditional plan, not a predicted price path. An arrow marks a level outside the view.
aiNoTradeDrawing: AI found no entry. The chart shows available support and resistance from this analysis; the reasoning and conditions for a reassessment are below.
aiPlanConditional: The chart shows one selected scenario. Activation requires the stated condition.
aiNoContextLevels: AI supplied no support or resistance. The chart shows NO TRADE status; missing levels are not invented.
paperEmptyPositionsHint: Your open positions appear here. Start with the order ticket.
paperEmptyPendingHint: Limit orders waiting to fill appear here.
paperInsufficient: Not enough funds for margin and the entry fee.
paperLeverageModel: Futures: 1–20× leverage with isolated margin. Each side costs 0.1% of position value. The engine requests a close when margin is exhausted; position losses are capped at its margin plus the entry fee. The liquidation estimate belongs to this simplified model, not an exchange. Funding, borrowing fees and maintenance-margin tiers are excluded.
